snippet.title: PlayStation - Seirei Shoukan - Princess of Darkness (1998) - Intro
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Seirei Shoukan: Princess of Darkness is a Role-Playing game, published by Shoeisha, which was released in Japan in 1998.
